title: Property & Casualty
meta_description: P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it.

blocks.x: P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it. Both are decision factories — rate against exposure and catastrophe models, settle against policy language and fraud signals — and both reward carriers whose document and data machinery is industrialized. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.
The ground truth of this sector

The work concentrates in fnol and claims triage, estimate review and leakage control, commercial risk surveying, with pricing/filing analytics close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
As operators describe it — Property & Casualty edition:

items: Claims packets unstructured
FNOL, estimates, medical and police files arrive as documents; triage takes days and leakage hides in the queue.
Pricing sophistication vs. filing discipline
Telematics and GLM pricing outrun validation and filing capacity; model risk documentation is rebuilt under exam.
Risk telemetry missing
Commercial properties and fleets lack sensor feeds; perils (water, freeze, telematics) are priced blind and prevented worse.
Exposure and claims silos
Underwriting exposure and claims experience never meet; portfolio steering is retrospective.
Broker/TPA ecosystem exposure
Third-party handlers hold sensitive claims data with uneven controls; the carrier owns the headline risk.
Cat model compute ceilings
Catastrophe model ensembles strain HPC; uncertainty quantification is truncated.

blocks.x: The proof in Property & Casualty is a working system on a real workflow. These are the builds that go live:

items: Claims triage agent
documents classified/extracted; straight-through for clean claims with audit replay
Estimate intelligence
repair estimates benchmarked against parts/labor data with anomaly flags
Portfolio pricing lakehouse
exposure + claims unified with lineage for actuaries
Commercial risk telemetry
water/freeze/telematics sensors feeding prevention and pricing
TPA security gating
third-party tiers, access reviews and evidence automation
